interface.longDescription:
Material is a personal library for you and your AI. Save links, passages, and ideas directly from ChatGPT, organize them into project spaces, and bring them back as context for what you create.

Keep what you discover on the web and your phone in the same library. Find saved material in ChatGPT and use it to develop writing, explore ideas, or guide a design.

SAVE FROM THE CONVERSATION
Bookmark a useful link or save a passage, idea, or summary as a note in Material. Add it to a project space so you can return to it later.

FIND WHAT YOU SAVED
Ask for saved material about a topic or explore a project space. Bring relevant sources and notes into the conversation without gathering them again from different apps.

CREATE WITH YOUR LIBRARY
Use saved images to guide an illustration, collected passages to develop a draft, or research to think through a product idea. Give ChatGPT context shaped by your taste and point of view.

For designers, writers, founders, researchers, and anyone who wants what they save to shape what they make.

Connect your Material account to get started. It is the same library you use on iPhone and the web.

Save to create.
